name: cocode
title: Cocode — talk in code
description: An editor for any language, even one that doesn't exist. Claude predicts your next lines as a ghost you accept with Tab, prepares the real program in the background, and reads what you send as a question, a task or a note. With your OK, Run executes Python and JavaScript on this machine in milliseconds.

cocode.changed.summary: The text settled (500 ms): {rev, text, lang, detected, cursor, selection, lines, prefix, by: human|claude|restore, delta?}. Predict the next lines with cocode.suggest.

cocode.ghost.accept.summary: The human accepted a ghost with Tab (or one word with Ctrl+Right): {rev, source: claude|local, text, partial}

cocode.ghost.reject.summary: The human dismissed a ghost: {rev, source, reason: esc|typed-away|moved}

cocode.ghost.request.summary: Suggest pressed (Alt+\) or picked from Doto's menu: wants a ghost now: {rev, text, lang, cursor, prefix}

cocode.build.request.summary: The human asked for the real program in a target language (Build pane select or Prepare): {rev, text, lang, target: auto|<lang>}

cocode.run.summary: Run pressed and the window could not run it itself (no local runner, a language it cannot run here, or Not now): {run, rev, text, lang, build?}. Run it and stream cocode.output.

cocode.ran.summary: The window ran the build on this machine: {run, rev, buildRev, lang, sandbox, exit, ms, timedOut, killed, stdout, stderr} (4 000-char tails). React; never run it again.

cocode.ask.summary: A question with the code: {question, rev, text, lang, line, selection?, source: toolbar|inline|menu}. Inline = a line starting with ?? ended with Enter.

cocode.export.summary: "Send to Claude": {label, intent: auto|ask|explain|do|fix|review|note, text, lang, rev, cursor, selection?, build?, runs?, annotations?, stats}. A handoff: answer in the transcript.

cocode.snapshot.summary: Answer to the cocode.snapshot command (re = command id): the export payload without intent

cocode.suggest.summary: Show the next lines as a ghost at the caret: {rev, text, at?, alternatives?, reason?, seq?, done?}. Up to 12 lines; "" clears. Stale revs show only while the prefix still matches.

cocode.seed.summary: Starting points for an empty editor, from memory and sessions: {items:[{id, label, text, lang?, hint?}]} (max 6)

cocode.build.summary: The real program for a rev: {rev, lang, code, status?: building|ready|failed, file?, notes?, seq?, done?}. Always replaces the window's own as-written build (source local).

cocode.output.summary: Run output: {run, stream: stdout|stderr|system, text, seq?, done?, exit?, ms?}; done:true with exit closes the run

cocode.insert.summary: Insert text, animated and undoable: {at: {line, col} | "cursor" | "end", text}

cocode.replace.summary: Replace lines from..to (1-based, inclusive) with text, animated and undoable: {from, to?, text}

cocode.set.summary: Replace the whole document (ask first): {text, lang?}. Undoable.

cocode.annotate.summary: A gutter marker with a floating note on a line: {line, text, kind?: note|ok|warn|error}; text "" removes, line 0 clears all

cocode.highlight.summary: Glow lines from..to: {from, to?, color?, ttl?}; ttl default 4000, 0 keeps, from 0 clears

cocode.focus.summary: Scroll a line into view and put the caret there: {line, col?}

cocode.load.summary: Restore a document (the resume command): {text, lang?, build?, runs?, annotations?, cursor?}. Silent except one cocode.changed {by:"restore"}.

cocode.snapshot.summary: Ask the window for its state; it replies with a cocode.snapshot event
